title: Birth in St. Bernard Parish and musicians from downriver
summary: Born July 14, 1893 in St. Bernard Parish; parents spoke French among themselves; talk of musicians from the plantations downriver such as Jimmy Newman and the Durands.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yeah. But you were born, you weren't born on a plantation? No, no. What's your birthday exactly? What's your birthday?

July 14th, 1893. Quatorze, yeah. Yeah. You know what that is? A St. Bernard Parish. Yeah. Do you speak French? No, no. Did your parents speak French? Yeah, they did, but they didn't speak with us, with the children, because they used that, so they wanted to say something they didn't want us to know, they'd talk French, and that's why they were taught now. Did you know Jimbo from down there? No, I didn't know him personally, but I knew of him.
